== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Restoration]].
* This skill can bypass [[Frozen Soil]]'s effect since this skill can indirectly resurrect party members and the caster.
** Cannot be cast in the range of a Frozen Soil spirit.
** Use this before Frozen Soil, to provide a means to resurrect your own team while suppressing enemy resurrections. 
* Combine with [[Feast of Souls]] for rapid healing after resurrection.  [[Rupture Soul]] or [[Spirit to Flesh]] can respectively provide damage or healing before resurrection.
* Can be recast with skills that shorten the recharge times of Binding Rituals, such as [[Soul Twisting]] or [[Ritual Lord]], to control when the resurrection occurs.
* If your entire party dies before this spirit does, you will not get resurrected.
* You can prevent enemy resurrections by using [[Signet of Binding]] on hostile Restoration spirits.

{{anomaly|This spirit will also resurrect creatures created via [[summoning stone]]s that were dead and in the area of the spirit.}}
